reviews.raw_body:
> fs/proc/task_mmu: a missing huge_ptep_modify_prot_start() in
> make_uffd_wp_huge_pte() can lose hardware Dirty/Accessed updates
> when PAGEMAP_SCAN write-protects a hugetlb PTE.

Queued for 6.18, thanks.

-- 
Thanks,
Sasha

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch series addresses six pre-existing bug fixes for the userfaultfd feature, specifically related to huge page management and protection updates. The patches were initially part of a larger working-set-tracking series but have been split out due to review feedback. They aim to prevent hardware Dirty/Accessed updates from being lost when PAGEMAP_SCAN write-protects hugetlb pages.
